tasks.title: Formalise requirements and glossary

inputs.evidence_type: user-intent baseline; no upstream technical verification

tasks.scope: Extract stable requirement IDs and a glossary from the existing concept; separate user requirements, proposals and open decisions.
acceptance: Cover software selection, volunteered resources, CEO delegation, cloud option, timed movement, clicked/scheduled backups and designated recovery access.
Map every requirement to its baseline source section and a proposed observable acceptance condition.
Preserve unresolved choices; do not select a stack or certify compatibility.

tasks.title: Define permissions and authority boundaries

inputs.evidence_type: user-intent baseline; no upstream technical verification

tasks.scope: Describe the proposed role/action matrix using the existing trust and concept baseline only.
acceptance: Cover CEO, appointed manager, hardware owner, member and recovery custodian.
Distinguish deploy, revoke, move, request backup, retrieve encrypted copy, decrypt and restore.
Record unresolved CEO succession, emergency access and delegation rules explicitly.

tasks.title: Define hardware offers and assignment fields

inputs.evidence_type: user-intent baseline; no upstream technical verification

tasks.scope: Specify a technology-neutral hardware offer and hosting assignment contract from the baseline.
acceptance: Include owner consent, resources, workloads, availability, expiry, timezone, movement window and backup-policy references.
Include invalid, withdrawn and offline cases plus synthetic examples.
Do not depend on another task schema; use locally defined terms and record reconciliation needs.

tasks.title: Specify backup and recovery outcomes

inputs.evidence_type: user-intent baseline; no upstream technical verification

tasks.scope: Specify manual/scheduled backup and recovery behaviour without choosing a storage vendor or encryption implementation.
acceptance: Separate requested, running, verified copy, failed and restore-tested outcomes.
Cover custodian access, key separation, offline hosts, retention questions and acceptable data-loss/recovery targets as unresolved values.
Define the evidence a later restore task must supply; claim no completed restore tests.

tasks.title: Define catalogue entry and evidence fields

inputs.evidence_type: user-intent baseline; no upstream technical verification

tasks.scope: Specify what a reviewed application/bundle entry must contain, using the baseline without researching candidate projects.
acceptance: Include exact upstream identity, licence, pinned version, dependency/bundle relationships, permissions, resources, deployment/update/rollback and backup/restore evidence.
Distinguish candidate, documentation-reviewed, component-tested and supported-for-specific-environment states.
Include evidence conditions/invalidation triggers and a synthetic unverified example; do not invent upstream facts.
